assumptions: Start: the change case has a selected meaning and a candidate; current UI on tab 01, proposed UI on the review screen with operation 1 selected. The first pointing operator of every flow starts at the virtual pointer rest position (720,450) used by the layout files.

The outcomes are NOT equivalent. The current UI shows no before state, so the reviewer learns only which actions changed (3 of the 4 operations; the ADDED state is not listed) from the JSON details. The proposed flow yields all 4 operations with before and after values. The current time is therefore a lower bound for the same question.

Reading is modelled as M (1.35 s, Card et al. 1980, described as crude by later authors). M counts are analyst judgement: current 9 (1 decision to look for what changed, 5 table rows, 3 JSON chunks), proposed 5 (summary plus one per operation). KLM covers expert, error-free, routine work and not review quality.

Current geometry is design/layouts/current-impact.json and current-evidence.json, MEASURED by the layout lane in one Chromium at 1440x900. Proposed geometry is a design target, not measured, and lives in Appendix A of docs/hci/design/evidence-and-change-review.md (review-proposed, review-proposed-trace), to be extracted to design/layouts/.

assumptions: Start: current UI on tab 02 (after review), proposed UI on the review screen; the pointer starts at the virtual rest position (720,450).

The outcomes are NOT equivalent. The current UI never renders the bound of the runtime matrix (125 cells, one step) or the verifier's limitations; the raw packet shows only 4 kernel-level limitations. The proposed flow shows the bound and the NOT covered slot at level 0.

The 2.73 s verification time is the slowest of several MEASURED runs of verify_runtime (2.73 s on the D: HDD inside the checkout; 1.88 s and 1.01 s in two audit runs on other disks; 1.41 to 1.52 s in three warm runs). Machine and disk dependence is large; 2.73 s is kept as a conservative upper value in both arms, so it cancels in the comparison but inflates absolute T06 totals. The validation plan measures it as a distribution (n = 20).
Palette alternative, not modelled: Ctrl+K, 6 typed characters, Enter is 9 keystroke units (1.8 s) plus an M (1.35 s), versus P+B on the visible Verify button (about 1 s).

assumptions: The current UI cannot show a failing cell: receipts, with all 125 observations, are in the API payload and the export but are never rendered. The current flow is a workaround through the exported JSON and an external editor. Its uncertainty is far larger than the 21 percent KLM band (external tools, file size, search hits) and the comparison is indicative only.

The example is a SEEDED FIXTURE for design and study: no failing cell exists in the kernel today (0 mismatches in 125). The FAIL row shows a hypothetical cell where an unassigned teacher's Recommend was accepted.
Multi-step traces (from model checking, ADR-0018) are not modelled; a one-step cell has one step. Step and Play controls are drawn for the general case.
